contentText: EU diplomats are travelling to Ukraine to mark the fourth anniversary of the massacre in the city of Bucha. It occurred only weeks into the war: after Russia evacuate the town, returnees found hundreds of bodies of men, women, children and elderly people who had been mass executed. FRANCE 24's Douglas Herbert looks back on an event that became a symbol of what many towns in Ukraine have experienced since the start of the war.
